correctness.rationale: For all G and nonempty A, the distance potential has unit magnitude against every admissible row. Its Rayleigh quotient gives universal 1/S. BFS forest exact probabilities attain Mv=v/S; Stieltjes ground-state decomposition establishes smallest eigenvalue; equality yields the full descending flow polytope; positive subtree masses prove uniqueness iff unique predecessor. 23,169 exact finite instances check identities but are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: An all-graph O(V+E) constructive E-optimal sampling solution replaces a numerical SDP. Complete optimal-face and uniqueness characterization explain network design flexibility and establish sparse support for dense graphs; these are meaningful structural and algorithmic gaps beyond standard randomized Kaczmarz rate bounds.
